CAUTION (review pass 1, MAJOR-2): 'Woodfree papers Nov 2025.xlsx' sheet 'Hangzhou Fuyung' carries the SAME invoice number with DIFFERENT figures ($16,545.60 / 17.23 MT — a partial-consignment view).
